candidate_requirements.requirement: Identify the participant/attack subset underlying each paired EDSS comparison (nadir vs pre-blockade vs three-month) as unreported and needed to interpret the P values.
candidate_requirements.rationale: The packet explicitly states the subset for every paired comparison is not established, which directly limits causal interpretation.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Requesting the paired individual-level data or the per-comparison n.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Identify the lack of a concurrent untreated control group and confounding by earlier corticosteroids/plasma exchange and spontaneous recovery as the key missing comparative evidence.

candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Requesting a controlled or adjusted analysis (e.g., propensity-matched comparison).
